criteria.requirement: A skill whose job is to write a Business Requirements Document from an approved PRD, cover happy, alternate, exception, and operational workflows, and block architecture finals until BRD approval is recorded.
evidence: The description states the job and includes a Use when trigger.
When to use and When NOT to use bound the job.
The default output path brd/BRD.md is named.

criteria.requirement: One procedure, one mode vocabulary, and a drafting step tied to the output template, so an agent writing a /brd document does not invent the artifact.
evidence: One procedure tells the agent which document to write.
Mode labels agree across the sections that declare them.
gaps: subskills/package.md does not point at brd-template.md.

criteria.requirement: The pack specifies every field /brd must put in the document. A localized gap that does not drop a required field scores 4.
evidence: trace to the PRD is specified.
architecture held for approval is specified.
gaps: No eval scenario is in the pack, so the skill cannot be regression-tested from its own references.

criteria.requirement: The happy path is executable: announce line, subskills, example, output path, and an approval question.
evidence: The subskill table points at files that exist.
A mini example shows the happy path.
The pack asks for explicit approval.
gaps: The happy path is executable, and an agent still has to choose a procedure or find the template.

criteria.requirement: Approval, risk tier, and stop rules are explicit for /brd, and skipped controls carry an owner plus a review date.
evidence: Drafts come before finals, and finals wait for approval.
Examples do not contain secret markers.
gaps: Pasted tickets and notes are not marked as untrusted input.
Deferred items require an owner and do not require a review date or compensating control.

criteria.requirement: The /brd pack is lean, scannable, and uses the canonical skill-card title.
evidence: SKILL.md is 116 lines, under the 500-line bar.
Depth sits in subskills and references.
gaps: The skill card title is '# SKILL_CARD â€” brd'.

description is 40–1024 characters, third person, and contains "Use when"
assertions.detail: Description is third person and states when to use the skill.
